description: Get the length of one place of a JSON file as one integer: an object = number of keys, an array = number of items, a string = number of characters. A number, boolean or null has no length (TargetBad). Example: {"path": "cfg.json#/tags"} prints 2.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.
